STAGE: final-answer
GOAL: produce one in-scope, implementable coupling idea that fixes the three measured failures (multiplicative weight with no arg-min move; curvature spent as radius; plan arg-max not reproducing marginals).
READ: no repo files were readable (external directory denied, cwd has only harness files), so the specification is written from the round evidence and standard RQ-VAE/TIGER structure (K=256 per level, L=3, batch ~1023, 24556 items/epoch, 24 steps).
OBSERVED / ANSWER SUMMARY: IDEA QPEX-CURVBIAS - quota-preserving SID exchange under an additive standardised-curvature Poincare bias.
 (a) ADDITIVITY: b_ik = lam_l * delta_l * centred d_P(u_i,v_k) is added to the Euclidean RQ cost; delta=0 makes the swap rule reject every move, so the output is exactly the Euclidean argmin (Hamming 0 assertion) and the top-1 change is measurable and reported per level.
 (b) EXACT RESOLUTION: assignment = Euclidean argmin a0 with histogram m_k, then count-preserving pairwise item/code SWAPS only; bucket sizes never change, so the histogram equals m_k by construction at every step, not via a plan.
 (c) CURVATURE SPENT NOT SHRUNK: delta_l (standardised curvature deviation) is a signed zero-mean re-ranking pressure only; ball radius fixed at 1, codebook vectors untouched, stop-gradient through u,v, so no radius can be spent.
 (d) MEASUREMENT: transitions from Stage-2 training split only, quotient graph on codes, Ollivier-Ricci with lazy walk alpha=0.5, standardised against R=20 size-preserving member shuffles, delta_l = z_l - mean z, reproduces [-0.328,-0.071,+0.399]; computed offline before Stage 2 and saved to config, so no in-loop rank-0 broadcast.
 (e) SWITCHES: behaviour off (delta=0 -> exact baseline assignment), geometry off (d_P replaced by Euclidean tangent distance, lambda recomputed), both on (only arm trained).
 OBSERVABLES: per-level digit Hamming vs Euclidean, exact histogram assertion, support 247/7414/20223 and collision ~0.177, prefix hit rates, teacher-forced next-digit NLL, Stage3 test_recall@10 vs 0.055537 / 0.065.
 COST: offline curvature <=2 min; per step ~16 MFLOP extra plus ~2.4M scalar ops => +5-15 percent step time, about +10-50 min over 3000 epochs.
RISKS: sign of delta may be wrong for recall and only one run is allowed; median-margin calibration makes the bias affect only the ambiguous half; tanh saturation flattens d_P; one swap sweep is a local optimum; curvature stale after epoch 0; triple collision may drift.
OPEN: none - final answer printed verbatim in the reply.
EVIDENCE: the round brief (measured curvature profile, round-1 collapse 0.041888, round-2 refusal of CURVCAP-SUCCPLAN, baseline 0.055537).
